title: onyx-dot-app/onyx: self-hosted chat, search, and agents for any model
friendlyTitle: Onyx is a self-hosted chat and search box for any model
summary: Onyx is an open-source AI platform for chat, retrieval, agents, and actions that works with whatever LLM you connect. The Community Edition is MIT-licensed and covers those core features. Enterprise features such as SSO, SCIM, role-based access, and usage analytics are separate. GitHub's daily Python trending list had it at 201 stars today. A hosted trial is at cloud.onyx.app if you do not want to deploy it.
friendlySummary: Onyx is an open-source AI platform for chat, search, agents, and actions. It works with whatever language model you connect. The Community Edition is under the MIT license and covers those core features. Enterprise features, such as single sign-on, SCIM, role-based access, and usage charts, are separate. GitHub's daily Python trending list had it at 201 stars today. A hosted trial is at cloud.onyx.app if you do not want to run it yourself.
whyItMatters: Use it when a team wants one chat and search box over its own documents, on a server it runs, instead of pasting files into a vendor chat. You still choose and pay for the model. The community edition is the part you can run without the enterprise license. Read the deployment docs before you point it at a private corpus.
